verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly promise 'Bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access' (paperspace-docs-12/19/21) and describe SSH connection setup (paperspace-docs-2), but a hands-on community report states 'Getting SSH access is an uphill battle; instead there's a pointless virtual console and confusing GUI' on Paperspace Core VMs, directly contradicting the frictionless SSH claim. Missing for 10: independent verification that SSH root access works smoothly as advertised, and resolution of the conflicting hands-on account.
